argv:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$root='E:\WebAIBridge-R70-GPT-PLANNER-20261014-GPT6'
$expected='14c085251a63411d5c50349dac0e124a82ef3766'
if(([string](& git.exe -C $root rev-parse HEAD)).Trim() -ne $expected){throw 'SOURCE_SHA_DRIFT'}
$plan=Join-Path $root 'app\data\r70-qa-verified-wave-plan.json'
$state=Join-Path $root 'app\data\r70-qa-verified-wave-state.json'
if(!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $plan) -or !(Test-Path -LiteralPath $state)){throw 'R70_PLAN_STATE_MISSING'}
$before=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $plan -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
$result=& node.exe (Join-Path $root 'app\r70-stage-gpt-planner.js') --stage $plan $state
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'STAGING_REPEAT_REFUSED_OR_FAILED'}
$v=($result|Out-String)|ConvertFrom-Json
$after=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $plan -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
Write-Output ('STAGE_REPEAT_NO_NEW_PLAN='+($v.created -eq $false))
Write-Output ('IDENTICAL_PLAN_HASH='+($before -eq $after))
Write-Output ('PLAN_DISPATCH_DISABLED='+(-not (Get-Content -LiteralPath $plan -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json).allowDispatch))
Write-Output ('CURRENT_ASSIGNMENTS='+@((Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:17448/api/supervisor-watchdog/agent-assignments' -TimeoutSec 3).assignments).Count)
Write-Output ('SOURCE_SHA='+(& git.exe -C $root rev-parse HEAD))
if($v.created -ne $false -or $before -ne $after){throw 'STAGING_NOT_IDEMPOTENT'}

note: Idempotence proof that repeated staging with unchanged authority does not overwrite plan, queue tasks or Send providers.
